description: Deploys a Regional REST API with a custom domain name, a Lambda backend function, and a request-based Lambda authorizer using AWS CLI. Covers ACM certificate provisioning, API Gateway REST API creation, Lambda function deployment, request authorizer setup, custom domain configuration, base path mapping, and Route 53 DNS record creation. Trigger keywords: custom domain, REST API, Lambda, Route 53, API Gateway, regional endpoint, request authorizer, base path mapping.
